"""Brute-force reference for small audit graphs."""
import itertools

def analyse(P,R,D,inp,states,edges,fair,start):
    n=len(states)
    # expected sums
    exp=[]
    for q in range(R):
        s=[0]*D
        for r in range(P):
            v=inp[r][q]
            for i in range(D): s[i]+=v[i]
        exp.append(s)
    def safe(st):
        dl=st["delivered"]
        for r in range(P):
            for q,v in enumerate(dl[r]):
                if v!=exp[q]: return False
        for s in st["slots"]:
            tot=[0]*D
            for r in s["ranks"]:
                v=inp[r][s["seq"]]
                for i in range(D): tot[i]+=v[i]
            if s["sum"]!=tot: return False
        return True
    def donest(st):
        return all(len(st["delivered"][r])==R for r in range(P))
    en={i:0 for i in range(n)}
    bit={a:1<<i for i,(a,m) in enumerate(fair)}
    for eid,(s,lab,t) in enumerate(edges):
        if lab in bit: en[s]|=bit[lab]
    # reachable from start
    reach={start}
    q=[start]
    while q:
        u=q.pop()
        for (s,lab,t) in edges:
            if s==u and t not in reach: reach.add(t); q.append(t)
    # safety over reachable
    saf=all(safe(states[u]) for u in reach)
    # termination: exists recurrent set F of non-done states, strongly connected in induced subgraph
    # (with the convention: single node trivially connected), reachable from start (through non-done)
    nondone=[i for i in range(n) if not donest(states[i])]
    exists=False; witness=None
    decl=[a for a,m in fair]
    weak=[bit[a] for a,m in fair if m=='weak']
    strongidx=[i for i,(a,m) in enumerate(fair) if m=='strong']
    # reachability graph restricted to nondone
    ndset=set(nondone)
    def bfs_from(s):
        seen={s}; stk=[s]
        while stk:
            u=stk.pop()
            for (a,lab,t) in edges:
                if a==u and t in ndset and t not in seen: seen.add(t); stk.append(t)
        return seen
    rreach = bfs_from(start) if start in ndset else set()
    for mask in range(1,1<<len(nondone)):
        F=[nondone[i] for i in range(len(nondone)) if (mask>>i)&1]
        Fset=set(F)
        if Fset & rreach or start in Fset:
            pass
        # strong connectivity of induced subgraph
        if len(F)==1:
            ok=True
        else:
            # check reachability among all pairs within F
            ok=True
            for s in F:
                seen={s}; stk=[s]
                while stk:
                    u=stk.pop()
                    for e in edges:
                        if e[0]==u and e[2] in Fset and e[2] not in seen: seen.add(e[2]); stk.append(e[2])
                if seen != Fset: ok=False; break
        if not ok: continue
        fair_ok=True
        for (a,m) in fair:
            b=bit[a]
            internal=any(e for e in edges if e[0] in Fset and e[2] in Fset and e[1]==a)
            enabled=any(en[s]&b for s in F)
            if m=='weak':
                if Fset <= set(s for s in F if en[s]&b) and not internal:
                    # F subset of En_a and no internal edge -> violated
                    if all(en[s]&b for s in F) and not internal: fair_ok=False; break
            else:
                if enabled and not internal: fair_ok=False; break
        if not fair_ok: continue
        # reachable from start through nondone: start in F or start reaches F in ndset
        rr = bfs_from(start) if start in ndset else set()
        if not (Fset & rr):
            continue
        exists=True; witness=F; break
    return saf, (not exists), witness
